papers.title: Neural Network identification of Dark Star Candidates. II. Spectroscopy
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, submitted to the Astrophysical Journal
papers.summary: A feedforward neural network trained on synthetic JWST/NIRSpec dark-star spectra identifies and characterizes candidates, re-confirming four supermassive dark star spectra and predicting parameters far faster.

papers.title: Agentic Systems for Calibrating Cosmological Simulations
papers.comment: Accepted to the 9th annual workshop for Machine Learning & the Physical Sciences (ML4PS). A starter code is available on https://github.com/chaipattira/SimulationCalibrator
papers.summary: AgenticTuner uses a present-day large language model as an optimizer to propose cosmological simulation parameters, achieving competitive calibration at reduced CPU cost with human-readable priors.

papers.title: Machine Learning Sensor Fusion for Water Vapor Radiometry based Tropospheric Delay Calibration
papers.comment: 2 pages, 1 table, Submitted to 2027 National Radio Science Meeting, Boulder, Colorado
papers.summary: A machine-learning sensor-fusion architecture uses atmospheric profiles, weather data and water-vapor radiometer spectra with a learned Kalman filter to estimate tropospheric delay for ngVLA/ALMA.
papers.tldr: A machine-learning based retrieval concept and a preliminary architecture, framed as heterogeneous, multi-rate sensor fusion, are proposed to correct for tropospheric phase fluctuations in the next-generation Very Large Array.

papers.title: Learning Galaxy Kinematics from Spatially Unresolved Spectra
papers.summary: A neural network trained on spatially resolved spectra infers galaxy kinematic parameters from spatially integrated spectra, enabling kinematic measurements for millions of unresolved galaxies.
